biocontainers.name: bioconductor-biocsingular
biocontainers.summary: Singular Value Decomposition for Bioconductor Packages

biotools.summary: Implements exact and approximate methods for singular value decomposition and principal components analysis, in a framework that allows them to be easily switched within Bioconductor packages or workflows. Where possible, parallelization is achieved using the BiocParallel framework.
